With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

Summary

The Senior Tax Manager leads and oversees the company’s tax function, ensuring accurate compliance, reporting, and planning across multiple jurisdictions. This role manages complex tax filings, directs tax provision processes, and ensures reconciliation and alignment with accounting standards. Acting as a strategic advisor, the Senior Tax Manager provides guidance on tax planning, business decisions, and risk management, while serving as a primary point of contact for audits and external advisors.

As a senior member of the finance function, this role partners closely with Finance, Legal, and Operations teams to support business growth and decision-making, drive process improvements, and implement scalable tax strategies.


Responsibilities

  • Review and Finalize Returns: Lead and manage the accurate and timely preparation and review of complex US federal and state/local income tax returns for various entities (C-Corp, S-Corp, Partnership, etc.). This often includes the final review before filing.

  • Income Tax Provision (ASC 740): Directly manage the quarterly and annual US income tax provision process under US GAAP (ASC 740), including the calculation of the Effective Tax Rate (ETR), deferred tax assets and liabilities, FIN 48/ASC 740-10 (Uncertain Tax Positions), and related financial statement disclosures.

  • Tax Account Reconciliation: Oversee the reconciliation of tax accounts, ensuring consistency between the general ledger, tax returns, and tax provision calculations.

  • Tax Research and Planning: Proactively monitor and research changes in US tax law (e.g., changes to the Internal Revenue Code, state tax legislation). Develop and implement tax planning strategies to legally minimize the Company's overall US tax liability.

  • Audit Management: Act as the primary point of contact for IRS, state, and local tax audits. Manage the audit defence process, prepare complex information requests, and negotiate with tax authorities.

  • Internal Consulting: Provide expert tax guidance and advice to senior management and internal departments (Finance, Legal, Operations) on the tax implications of major business decisions, transactions, and restructuring.

  • Process Improvement: Drive the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of tax processes, controls, and technology (tax software, ERP systems) to enhance efficiency and ensure proper governance.

  • Team Leadership: Supervise, mentor, train, and develop junior tax staff, senior accountants, and analysts, managing their workflows and performance.

  • External Advisor Management: Manage relationships and deliverables from outside tax advisors, consultants, and external auditors (e.g., Big 4 firms), ensuring work is timely, cost-effective, and aligned with company strategy.


Desired skills and competencies

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance from an accredited university. A focus on Taxation is highly preferred.

  • CPA certification (or equivalent professional accounting qualification for EMEA, e.g., ACA, ACCA, CIMA) strongly preferred.

  • Law degree and/or MBA a strong plus.

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in corporate tax accounting, compliance, and/or tax provision preparation, preferably in a large multinational corporation (MNC) and/or a Big4 public accounting firm.

  • Demonstrated experience in preparing and reviewing complex tax returns and calculating Effective Tax Rates (ETR) / tax provisions (ASC 740 / IAS 12).

  • Solid understanding of relevant tax laws, accounting principles (US GAAP/ IFRS), and tax regulations applicable to the US.

  • Proactive and experienced communicator with the ability to articulate complex tax concepts clearly to non-tax professionals and influence cross-organizational processes.

  • Highly analytical, efficient, and creative problem-solver, comfortable with ambiguity, complexity, and nuance in tax matters.

  • Computer software skills: Proficient in MS Office tools (especially Excel for tax calculations and data analysis); Experience with tax preparation software (e.g., OneSource, GoSystem, SAP Tax) and/or ERP systems is a significant advantage.

  • Excellent communication (both verbal and written) and strong writing skills in English.

  • Ability to work closely with others in a team environment and establish positive working relationships, while also demonstrating independent drive and professionalism in a multinational setting.


Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all. 

Some things you’ll enjoy

  • Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location

  • Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country

  • The flexibility of remote work, including optional WeWork access

At Deel, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of  race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @deel.com and other acquired company emails like @payspace.com and @paygroup.com. You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page.

Deel is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects different abilities, backgrounds, beliefs, experiences, identities and perspectives.

Deel will provide accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via this link and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation. If you have difficulty accessing the form, please email at recruiting@deel.com.

As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations.

This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. As a fully remote company, we also utilise AI-powered deepfake and fraud detection technologies to verify the authenticity of candidate identities and interactions during assessments and interviews. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. Your personal data is not used to train AI models. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Policy.

  • For NYC Residents: In accordance with NYC Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on AEDT; results are available at Ashby, Covey.

  • Collaborate with Product, Operations, Legal, and Enablement to advocate for prospect needs, accelerate deal velocity, and refine value messaging.

  • Stay ahead of evolving trends in global workforce IT support.

  • Comfort discussing APIs, data flows, and systems architecture with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills - able to simplify complex solutions and clearly articulate ROI.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration instincts and the ability to manage competing priorities in fast-moving sales cycles.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50,  Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator’s top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

The Senior Operations Manager will be responsible for leading and executing the administration and improvement of the systems, tools and processes that power our teams. You will be empowered to own, build, and shape the strategy and tactics that drive the effectiveness and efficiency of the Customer Success team and Deel overall.

Responsibilities

 - Manage day-to-day operational workflows and identify areas for efficiency improvements.

 - Support automation initiatives to reduce manual processes and improve accuracy and speed.

 - Partner with cross-functional teams to streamline tools and processes for both internal teams and customers.

 - Ensure adherence to operational controls, compliance requirements, and risk management practices.

 - Contribute to fraud prevention and regulatory alignment efforts by maintaining strong operational standards.

 - Monitor operational performance metrics and escalate risks or gaps to leadership.

 - Drive customer-focused process improvements to enhance turnaround times, resolution quality, and escalation handling.

 - Expand and improve self-service options to reduce dependency on manual support.

 - Implement regular feedback loops to capture insights and inform continuous improvement.

 - Coordinate operational readiness for new product or market launches, working closely with cross-functional stakeholders.

 - Assist with go-to-market initiatives by removing bottlenecks and ensuring smooth adoption.

 - Track and report operational outcomes, providing insights and recommendations to leadership.

 - Execute operational projects and strategic initiatives in collaboration with senior leaders.

Qualifications

 - 8+ years of experience in operations, preferably in a fast-paced environment (Tech/FinTech start-up experience a plus).

 - Demonstrated ability to manage and mentor small to mid-sized teams.

 - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail with a solutions-oriented mindset.

 - KPI-driven, with experience tracking and improving performance metrics.

 - Exposure to process automation and operational tooling.

 - Background in FinTech, consulting, banking, or fast-paced start-ups preferred.

 - Strong analytical skills with ability to turn data into actionable insights (SQL familiarity a plus).

 - Collaborative team player with high energy and a bias for action.

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all. 

Some things you’ll enjoy

 - Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location

 - Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country

 - The flexibility of remote work, including optional WeWork access

At Deel, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of  race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @deel.com http://deel.com and other acquired company emails like @payspace.com http://payspace.com and @paygroup.com http://paygroup.com. You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page https://www.deel.com/careers.

Deel is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects different abilities, backgrounds, beliefs, experiences, identities and perspectives.

Deel will provide accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via this link https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Deel/form/accommodation-requests and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation. If you have difficulty accessing the form, please email at recruiting@deel.com.

As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations.

This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. As a fully remote company, we also utilise AI-powered deepfake and fraud detection technologies to verify the authenticity of candidate identities and interactions during assessments and interviews. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. Your personal data is not used to train AI models. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Policy https://www.deel.com/legal/privacy-policy/.

 - For NYC Residents: In accordance with NYC Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on AEDT; results are available at Ashby https://www.ashbyhq.com/downloadables/ashby-bias-audit-08-2024.pdf, Covey https://getcovey.com/nyc-local-law-144.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

About the Role

We’re seeking a highly strategic and execution-oriented Staff Product Manager to lead the development of AI-driven immigration technology that enables fast, compliant, and automated visa case management across U.S. and global markets.

This role demands someone who can hit the ground running, to envision and execute streamline visa case processing across both employer-sponsored and standalone immigration pathways—with a strong focus on compliance, speed, and user experience.

You’ll work directly with C-level executives to shape the product vision, prioritise growth opportunities, and manage multiple senior stakeholder needs—all while delivering features that enhance global mobility, reduce processing time, and drive revenue.

Responsibilities

  • Translate complex legal and immigration frameworks (e.g., H-1B, PERM, L-1, O-1, global transfers) into intuitive, scalable platform experiences.

  • Build and launch AI-powered, automation-first features for document parsing, eligibility checks, predictive timelines, and real-time compliance tracking.

  • Deeply analyze customer needs and business problems to identify pain points and growth opportunities.

  • Rapidly develop impactful and elegant solutions to address specific problems and optimize user experiences.

  • Strategically think about the product from a high-level perspective, connecting the missing dots and shaping the roadmap for growth.

  • Take full ownership of your work throughout the entire product development lifecycle, from ideation to design, review, feedback, testing, and post-release analysis.

  • Collaborate closely with a team of highly talented Product Designers, Engineers and Growth experts to execute your vision and deliver exceptional results.

  • Embrace the opportunity to redefine the way people work globally and contribute to our journey of innovation.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 7 years of product management experience in a fast-paced environment, preferably with scale-ups or startups.

  • Strong expertise in building products with complex compliance or regulatory considerations including HR tech, fintech, mobility or similar.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and autonomously, leading initiatives and driving growth with minimal supervision.

  • Strong PLG mindset and appetite to focus on business metrics rather than owning one customer problem or area

  • Strong understanding of both user experience (UX) and user interface (UI) principles, ensuring the product delivers seamless and intuitive experiences.

  • Experience in A/B testing, experimentation, and leveraging data-driven insights to optimize product performance and drive growth.

  • Prior knowledge of B2B experience, SEO knowledge, and expertise in optimizing SEO and conversion funnels is a plus.

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all. 

Some things you’ll enjoy

  • Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location

  • Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country

  • The flexibility of remote work, including optional WeWork access

At Deel, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of  race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @deel.com and other acquired company emails like @payspace.com and @paygroup.com. You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page.

Deel is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects different abilities, backgrounds, beliefs, experiences, identities and perspectives.

Deel will provide accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via this link and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation. If you have difficulty accessing the form, please email at recruiting@deel.com.

As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations.

This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. As a fully remote company, we also utilise AI-powered deepfake and fraud detection technologies to verify the authenticity of candidate identities and interactions during assessments and interviews. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. Your personal data is not used to train AI models. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Policy.

  • For NYC Residents: In accordance with NYC Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on AEDT; results are available at Ashby, Covey.

With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

The Opportunity

As we continue to scale, White Label (WL) has emerged as the fastest-growing and most strategic part of our business—already home to our highest-spending customers and poised to become a $1B+ revenue stream. Today, White Label spans more than 64 product teams.

We are seeking a visionary, hands-on General Manager to build and scale Deel’s White Label business into a standalone SaaS platform. This role will own the full White Label P&L and lead the strategy, execution, and cross-functional alignment required to unlock its massive potential. Reporting to the COO/CEO, you will lead a cross-functional team, with additional dotted-line reporting relationships across the organization.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and scale the White Label business end-to-end, including P&L, growth strategy, execution, and operating cadence.

  • Build a SaaS business by serving a book of ISV customers who resell Deel solutions across their full client bases.

  • Set the vision and strategy for White Label, aligning product, engineering, sales, operations, and GTM teams around a unified roadmap.

  • Drive internal alignment across 60+ product teams, ensuring White Label becomes a first-class priority across the company.

  • Partner deeply with Product and Engineering to develop API-first, plug-and-play solutions that reduce onboarding friction and manual effort.

  • Lead hands-on execution, going deep where needed to unblock progress, validate solutions, and accelerate outcomes.

  • Use data and customer insight to guide decision-making, prioritize investments, and evolve the product offering.

  • Act as the internal and external thought leader on White Label, ISV partnerships, regulatory considerations, and market opportunities.

  • Ensure operational excellence, delivery quality, and scalable processes as the business grows rapidly.

What We’re Looking For

  • 15+ years of experience across operations, general management, and/or human capital management.

  • Proven track record of hands-on leadership scaling high-growth businesses and owning P&L at a senior or executive level.

  • Experience building and scaling platform, SaaS, or API-driven products (not purely managed services).

  • Ability to lead complex, global, matrixed organizations and influence without direct authority.

  • Strong product intuition and customer empathy, with the ability to translate insights into clear strategy and execution.

  • Exceptional problem-solving, prioritization, and decision-making skills in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  • Outstanding communication and executive presence, with credibility across C-suite and cross-functional partners.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a high-growth technology company or startup environment.

  • Exposure to HR tech, workforce platforms, or regulated global products.

  • Background working with ISVs, channel partners, or embedded/white-label solutions.

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all. 

Some things you’ll enjoy

  • Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location

  • Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country

  • The flexibility of remote work, including optional WeWork access

If you require accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via this link and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation. If you have difficulty accessing the form, please email at recruiting@deel.com.

Who’s behind Deel?

We are a global collective of entrepreneurs who love to build and solve problems. Our team is made up of self-driven people spanning 25+ countries, a unified, yet diverse culture keeps us consistently learning and improving. We're curious, courageous, optimistic, fair, and thoughtful.

We want to enable companies to hire the best talent from anywhere in the world. We do so by building tools our customers love with market-leading technology and expertise. We run on three words, fast, delightful and compliant.

As a team, we care while finding comfort and enjoyment in working together. We believe "less is more," and our highly efficient team speaks to that. After all, we want to take Deel public with a group of less than 100. Are you in?

So, why now?

A significant shift has occurred within the workforce as we know it, changing business norms drastically. At Deel, we genuinely see a world without borders, but we needed to challenge that to make it happen. A 30-mile hiring radius limit shouldn't exist for companies, since great talent lives everywhere. The global talent market is quickly accelerating, we are here to stay ahead of multi-jurisdictional legislation, allowing maturation and acceptance of remote work across all levels of the value chain.

Deel is the market leader in international payroll and compliance. With over $50 million raised from Andreessen Horowitz, Spark Capital, Y Combinator, Elad Gil, Nat Friedman, Alexis Ohanian, and Daniel Gross, there's never been a more exciting time to join the team.

Duties

  • Venture Capital firms: Partner with select venture firms to extend Deel’s reach, support their portfolio companies, and create joint engagement opportunities.

  • Accelerators and Ecosystem partners: Own the day-to-day relationship with Accelerator and Incubator program teams, in addition to other ecosystem partners, ensuring Deel is positioned as the go-to global hiring and payroll partner

  • Founder Engagement: Act as the first point of contact for portfolio companies, educating founders on Deel’s solutions, answering questions, and connecting them with the right internal teams

  • Quota Ownership: Consistently meet or exceed quota by generating pipeline and revenue from accelerator and venture-backed startups

  • Outbound Relationship Building: Develop new founder, accelerator, and venture contacts and build a self-sustaining network of evangelists

  • Events & Touchpoints: Represent Deel at demo days, founder dinners, alumni mixers, and venture/accelerator ecosystem events, deepening relationships and driving visibility

  • Co-Marketing Campaigns: Ideate and execute campaigns tailored to founders (office hours, workshops, content, events) in coordination with partners and internal teams

  • Partnership Growth: Identify opportunities within accelerator and venture ecosystems to expand Deel’s reach and influence

  • Performance Tracking: Maintain and report on key program metrics including founder engagement, pipeline generation, and revenue conversion

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, sales, or program management, ideally with accelerators, venture capital, or founder-facing initiatives

  • Authentic relationship building skills and extremely self-motivated and success-driven

  • Deep experience in a customer or partner-facing role, with a track record of top performance

  • A passion for technology, start-ups, and supporting other businesses as they grow

  • Demonstrated analytical skills, particularly the ability to measure program impact/success

  • Excellent written and spoken English, with strong storytelling skills to engage founders and partners

  • A proactive and highly independent self-starter and who works well in a high-growth environment where things change quickly

  • Strong collaborator across marketing, sales, and product teams

  • Subject matter expertise on global people operations is a plus

  • Experience as a founder, at an accelerator or venture capital firm is a plus

  • A strong network across venture capital firms and accelerators is a plus

  • Must speak English, Portuguese and Spanish fluently

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all. 

Some things you’ll enjoy

  • Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location

  • Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country

  • The flexibility of remote work, including optional WeWork access

Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @deel.com and other acquired company emails like @payspace.com and @paygroup.com. You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page.

Deel is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects different abilities, backgrounds, beliefs, experiences, identities and perspectives.

Deel will provide accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via this link and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation. If you have difficulty accessing the form, please email at recruiting@deel.com.

As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations.

This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. As a fully remote company, we also utilise AI-powered deepfake and fraud detection technologies to verify the authenticity of candidate identities and interactions during assessments and interviews. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. Your personal data is not used to train AI models. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Policy.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, you know how to tell simple, but compelling stories with data

  • You work well with people across the spectrum 

  • Highly proficient in SQL 

  • Experience in data visualization tooling (we use Looker)

  • Some experience in data modeling and metrics design

  • You have a worked with dbt and LookML

  • You have experience using Sales platforms like Salesforce, Gong or Outreach

Summary
As Associate Director of US Tax Operations, you will own and lead Deel’s end-to-end US tax operations across US EOR, PEO, managed client payroll, self-service employer payroll, and Deel’s internal US entities. This role is accountable for tax compliance strategy, execution, operational scalability, systems governance, vendor oversight, and tax quality across all US payroll products and client segments.

You will lead multi-disciplinary tax operations teams responsible for withholdings, remittances, filings, amendments, agency responses, and escalations, while partnering closely with Payroll Operations, Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Finance, Revenue, and Customer Experience to deliver accurate, compliant, and scalable US payroll tax outcomes.

This role requires deep US employment tax expertise, strong people leadership, and hands-on experience with enterprise payroll and tax platforms (including Prism, MasterTax, and comparable systems). You will operate as a senior subject-matter leader, balancing regulatory rigor with automation, efficiency, and client experience.

Responsibilities

US Tax Strategy & Ownership

  • Own the end-to-end US tax operating model across:

    • US PEO tax operations

    • US EOR tax operations

    • Managed US employer payroll tax (external clients)

    • Self-service US employer payroll tax (external clients)

    • Deel internal US payroll tax operations

  • Define and execute the US tax operations strategy, including scalability plans, automation roadmap, vendor approach, and risk mitigation.

  • Establish and maintain tax governance frameworks, controls, policies, documentation, and escalation models.

  • Serve as a senior operational authority for US tax matters across leadership, product, legal, and risk forums.

  • Partner with Legal, Risk, and Compliance to interpret regulatory changes impacting PEO, co-employment, and EOR models.

Tax Compliance, Filings & Regulatory Management

  • Ensure accurate and compliant execution of:

    • Federal, state, and local tax withholdings and remittances

    • Quarterly and annual filings (941, 940, W-2, W-3, state & local equivalents)

    • Amended filings, corrections, and prior-period adjustments

    • Agency registrations, account maintenance, and jurisdictional setup

  • Lead responses to agency notices, audits, penalties, inquiries, and enforcement actions.

  • Maintain expert-level knowledge of US employment tax regulations, including multi-state complexity, local jurisdictions, reciprocity rules, and wage & hour implications.

  • Partner with our Compliance team to translate regulatory changes into operational procedures, system updates, and training.

Tax Systems, Tools & Automation

  • Own tax systems strategy, configuration, and optimization across:

    • Prism

    • MasterTax

    • Payroll engines, tax engines, and supporting reconciliation tools

  • Partner with Compliance, Product and Engineering to:

    • Define tax system requirements and product roadmaps

    • Improve automation, exception handling, and straight-through processing

    • Reduce manual work, error rates, and cost-to-serve

  • Support system implementations, migrations, integrations, and acquisitions impacting US tax operations.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing US Tax Operations organization, including team leads, specialists, and senior ICs.

  • Define org design, role clarity, capacity models, career paths, and skills development.

  • Establish performance management frameworks tied to accuracy, timeliness, efficiency, and client outcomes.

  • Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

Operational Excellence, Metrics & Reporting

  • Define and own US tax operations KPIs, including:

    • Filing and remittance accuracy

    • On-time filing and payment rates

    • Error, rerun, and amendment rates

    • Cost, productivity, and automation metrics

  • Deliver regular executive-level reporting, insights, and risk assessments.

  • Lead root-cause analysis for tax incidents and implement durable corrective actions.

  • Continuously improve workflows, controls, documentation, and reporting to support scale.

Cross-Functional & Partner Leadership

  • Act as the primary US tax operations partner to:

    • Payroll Operations (execution, handoffs, issue resolution)

    • Product & Engineering (systems, automation, roadmap)

    • Legal & Compliance (regulatory interpretation, risk)

    • Finance & Accounting (reconciliations, audits, GL impact)

    • Revenue, CX, and Implementations (client success, transitions, escalations)

  • Provide operational input into product design, go-to-market strategy, and client enablement for US tax operations offerings.

  • Champion a client-first mindset, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and trust at scale.

Qualifications

  • 7–10+ years of progressive experience in US tax operations, payroll tax compliance, or payroll operations, including:

    • Multi-state and local tax complexity

    • Federal, state, and local filings and remittances

    • PEO and/or EOR operating models

  • 3–5+ years of people leadership experience, managing managers and/or complex operational teams.

  • Deep expertise in US employment tax compliance, controls, audits, reconciliations, and risk management.

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise payroll and tax systems, including:

    • Prism

    • MasterTax

    • Comparable payroll and tax engines

  • Proven ability to scale operations in high-growth, multi-product, or enterprise environments.

  • Strong operational judgment with the ability to balance compliance, automation, client experience, and speed.

  • Data-driven leader experienced in using metrics and KPIs to drive outcomes.

Total Rewards

Who we are is what we do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50,  Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator’s top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

Summary

The Sales Development Representative plays a critical role in driving top-of-funnel growth across a defined segment or product. This role is responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying prospective customers through inbound and outbound prospecting. By uncovering client needs, educating prospects, and generating qualified opportunities, the SDR directly contributes to pipeline development and overall revenue performance. The position requires strong communication skills, curiosity, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Responsibilities

  • Generate new business opportunities through inbound and outbound prospecting, including email, phone, social channels, events, and campaigns.

  • Identify, research, and qualify prospective clients by understanding their needs, challenges, and readiness to engage with sales.

  • Create and execute outreach sequences, including personalized email campaigns and cold-calling to map and penetrate accounts.

  • Engage existing customers as needed to identify cross-sell or expansion opportunities across a defined segment or product (as applicable to the team).

  • Educate and nurture leads to progress them toward a qualified meeting or next step in the buyer journey.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date lead and activity data in CRM and sales engagement tools.

  • Collaborate with Account Executives to ensure smooth and effective handoff of qualified opportunities.

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, and other teams to continuously refine lead-generation processes, messaging, and workflow improvements.

  • Achieve or exceed monthly and quarterly targets for qualified meetings, Sales Qualified Opportunities, and pipeline contribution.

  • Participate in ongoing training, coaching, and skill development.

Qualifications

  • Experience in a sales development, business development, or outbound commercial role (experience level may vary depending on team needs).

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage prospects across multiple channels.

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic, and remote-friendly environment.

  • Highly organized, self-motivated, and able to manage multiple priorities and outreach activities simultaneously.

  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding activity and pipeline-generation targets.

  • Comfortable working autonomously, taking initiative, and sourcing solutions independently.

  • Experience with CRM systems and sales engagement tools is a plus.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong growth orientation; adaptable to changes in process, product, or market focus.

  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to craft compelling outreach messages and campaign sequences.

  • Experience in HR tech, fintech, or high-growth startup environments is beneficial but not required.

  • Fully proficient in Danish or Finnish.

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.

  • Proficient in Jira, Salesforce, Looker, and other relevant tools

  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google equivalents

Summary

This role will manage the relocation, immigration, and mobility needs of Deel’s global workforce. You’ll work closely with HR, legal, and tax teams to ensure that employees on international assignments or relocations receive seamless support while staying compliant with local regulations. This role will help Deel expand its global talent pool and facilitate the movement of employees across multiple regions.

Responsibilities

  • Manage immigration cases from start to finish either in-house or through a third party provider with the majority of those being more complex.

  • Ensure cases are accurately updated on a case management system and actioned in a timely manner in accordance with set SLAs/KPIs.

  • Be a point of contact for low to medium level issues/escalations for other team members within the immigration team.

  • Give expert advice on immigration laws within Australia ensuring client’s compliance with current regulations.

  • Provide consultations (via email or call) to clients clearly outlining applicable immigration/work authorization routes.

  • Deliver outstanding client service through clear, professional communication and proactive case management.

  • Stay up to date with changes in immigration law and policies in assigned countries, proactively communicating any potential risks/changes that may impact clients/employees.

  • Assess right-to-work requirements for Employee of Records (EORs) and other types of permits.

  • Liaise with internal teams for corporate document gathering and work closely with other internal departments to ensure efficient case management.

  • Show strong understanding of country specific immigration processes, compliance requirements and act as a subject matter expert for assigned countries/regions.

  • Have immigration documents correctly updated, tracked and audited to ensure compliance and timely initiation of renewals.

  • Support in auditing and maintaining internal knowledge base on immigration requirements to ensure its accuracy.

  • Work on immigration/process improvement projects, as assigned.

  • Maintain compliance with OMARA requirements, including Code of Conduct obligations, documentation standards, and annual CPD

  • Conduct VEVO checks and ensure adherence to employer sponsorship obligations when applicable

Qualifications

  • 5-7 years of progressive mobility experience, with at least 2–3 years as an Immigration Specialist or in similar roles

  • Must be a Registered Migration Agent (RMA) with OMARA

  • Ideally law degree or similar field or paralegal

  • Fluent in English

  • Strong knowledge of the key immigration categories

  • Excellent communication and the ability to find solutions under pressure, with thoughtful people management and mentorship skills

  • Ability to interpret and communicate immigration policies and processes

Total Rewards

About the role

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager for Deel IT, you will own the go-to-market strategy for a core part of Deel’s platform. This role goes far beyond launches, you’ll define the narrative, influence product direction, enable Sales and Customer teams, and drive adoption and expansion across our customer base.

You’ll operate at the intersection of Product, Demand Gen, Sales, and Customer Success, acting as the connective tissue that turns product capabilities into clear value, strong GTM execution, and measurable business impact.

This is a highly strategic, high-ownership role for a PMM who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys shaping both strategy and execution.

What you’ll do

1. Product & Marketing Strategy

  • Define and drive the long-term product marketing strategy for the Deel IT portfolio, aligning product direction, customer needs, and business priorities.

  • Set clear focus and prioritization across initiatives to ensure momentum and impact.

  • Translate product strategy into a clear GTM roadmap with strong sequencing and ownership.

2. Messaging & Positioning

  • Own the end-to-end narrative for Deel IT, from high-level positioning to detailed product and feature messaging.

  • Define, validate, and evolve messaging that clearly differentiates Deel in the IT market and resonates with buyers, users, and internal teams.

  • Ensure consistent, high-quality messaging across website, campaigns, launches, and sales materials.

3. Product Launches & Go-To-Market (GTM)

  • Lead GTM strategy and execution for launches, iterations, and expansions.

  • Define target audiences, use cases, value propositions, and launch plans across channels.

  • Partner closely with Product, Demand Gen, and Brand to ensure launches reach the right audience with the right message at the right time.

4. Buyer, Customer, Sales & CSM Enablement

  • Equip Sales and Customer Success teams with clear, consistent, and actionable enablement, including sales narratives, pitch decks, one-pagers, demos, and proof points.

  • Ensure teams deeply understand who the product is for, why it matters, and how to sell, implement, and expand it confidently.

  • Continuously improve enablement based on feedback from the field.

5. Acquisition, Cross-Sell and Adoption

  • Drive adoption and expansion by partnering with Demand Gen and Lifecycle teams on targeted programs, experiments, and cross-sell plays.

  • Activate existing customers through GTM motions tied to real customer needs and usage moments.

  • Influence onboarding, in-app messaging, and lifecycle campaigns to increase product usage and stickiness.

6. Performance & Feedback Loop

  • Run a regular performance loop with Demand Gen to review results and refine messaging, offers, targeting, and GTM plays.

  • Use quantitative data and qualitative insights to continuously improve conversion, adoption, and revenue impact.

  • Bring structured feedback from the field back to Product to help inform roadmap decisions and prioritization.

What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of experience in Product Marketing within SaaS, ideally in the IT, hardware/software, or device management space.

  • Proven experience owning end-to-end go-to-market, including positioning, launches, enablement, and adoption.

  • Strong experience partnering closely with Product teams to help shape roadmaps, using customer insights, market signals, and GTM learnings to influence direction and priorities.

  • Ability to translate complex, technical products into clear, compelling stories for buyers, users, and internal teams.

  • Data-driven mindset, comfortable using metrics and qualitative feedback to guide decisions and optimization.

  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth, and fully remote environments.

  • High ownership mentality, comfortable setting direction, driving alignment, and executing with speed.

Why this role matters

This role is foundational to the success of Deel IT. You’ll help define how the product is understood, positioned, sold, and adopted and directly influence pipeline growth, customer expansion, and product direction.

If you’re excited about owning GTM strategy end to end, shaping product narratives, and working cross-functionally to drive real business impact, this role is for you.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager for Deel IT, you will own the go-to-market strategy for a core part of Deel’s platform. This role goes far beyond launches, you’ll define the narrative, influence product direction, enable Sales and Customer teams, and drive adoption and expansion across our customer base.

You’ll operate at the intersection of Product, Demand Gen, Sales, and Customer Success, acting as the connective tissue that turns product capabilities into clear value, strong GTM execution, and measurable business impact.

This is a highly strategic, high-ownership role for a PMM who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys shaping both strategy and execution.


WHAT YOU’LL DO


1. PRODUCT & MARKETING STRATEGY

 - Define and drive the long-term product marketing strategy for the Deel IT portfolio, aligning product direction, customer needs, and business priorities.

 - Set clear focus and prioritization across initiatives to ensure momentum and impact.

 - Translate product strategy into a clear GTM roadmap with strong sequencing and ownership.


2. MESSAGING & POSITIONING

 - Own the end-to-end narrative for Deel IT, from high-level positioning to detailed product and feature messaging.

 - Define, validate, and evolve messaging that clearly differentiates Deel in the IT market and resonates with buyers, users, and internal teams.

 - Ensure consistent, high-quality messaging across website, campaigns, launches, and sales materials.


3. PRODUCT LAUNCHES & GO-TO-MARKET (GTM)

 - Lead GTM strategy and execution for launches, iterations, and expansions.

 - Define target audiences, use cases, value propositions, and launch plans across channels.

 - Partner closely with Product, Demand Gen, and Brand to ensure launches reach the right audience with the right message at the right time.
   


4. BUYER, CUSTOMER, SALES & CSM ENABLEMENT

 - Equip Sales and Customer Success teams with clear, consistent, and actionable enablement, including sales narratives, pitch decks, one-pagers, demos, and proof points.

 - Ensure teams deeply understand who the product is for, why it matters, and how to sell, implement, and expand it confidently.

 - Continuously improve enablement based on feedback from the field.


5. ACQUISITION, CROSS-SELL AND ADOPTION

 - Drive adoption and expansion by partnering with Demand Gen and Lifecycle teams on targeted programs, experiments, and cross-sell plays.

 - Activate existing customers through GTM motions tied to real customer needs and usage moments.

 - Influence onboarding, in-app messaging, and lifecycle campaigns to increase product usage and stickiness.
   


6. PERFORMANCE & FEEDBACK LOOP

 - Run a regular performance loop with Demand Gen to review results and refine messaging, offers, targeting, and GTM plays.

 - Use quantitative data and qualitative insights to continuously improve conversion, adoption, and revenue impact.

 - Bring structured feedback from the field back to Product to help inform roadmap decisions and prioritization.
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7+ years of experience in Product Marketing within SaaS, ideally in the IT, hardware/software, or device management space.

 - Proven experience owning end-to-end go-to-market, including positioning, launches, enablement, and adoption.

 - Strong experience partnering closely with Product teams to help shape roadmaps, using customer insights, market signals, and GTM learnings to influence direction and priorities.

 - Ability to translate complex, technical products into clear, compelling stories for buyers, users, and internal teams.

 - Data-driven mindset, comfortable using metrics and qualitative feedback to guide decisions and optimization.

 - Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills.

 - Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth, and fully remote environments.

 - High ownership mentality, comfortable setting direction, driving alignment, and executing with speed.
   

Why this role matters

This role is foundational to the success of Deel IT. You’ll help define how the product is understood, positioned, sold, and adopted and directly influence pipeline growth, customer expansion, and product direction.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

The Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, and maintenance of Deel’s core internal infrastructure. The Infrastructure Engineer ensures the reliability, security, and scalability of the backbone systems that keep the company running globally. You will oversee cloud-based services, identity providers, and network connectivity, ensuring high availability of all internal systems and leading the transition toward a fully automated and secure corporate environment.

Responsibilities

  • Saturday through Wednesday week (with Thursday and Friday off)

  • Design, deploy, and manage Deel’s global IT infrastructure, focusing on high availability, scalability, and security of internal services.

  • Administer and optimize core cloud platforms and identity providers (e.g., Google Workspace, Okta), ensuring secure and seamless access management.

  • Implement and maintain Zero Trust architecture and advanced SAML/SSO integrations across all corporate applications.

  • Automate infrastructure tasks and internal workflows using scripting languages to reduce manual intervention and improve system efficiency.

  • Manage corporate network connectivity and security, including VPNs, SD-WAN, and firewall configurations for global offices.

  • Partner with the Security team to implement hardening standards, vulnerability patching, and compliance controls across the IT landscape.

  • Act as a Tier 3 escalation point for complex technical issues that impact core infrastructure or cross-platform integrations.

  • Oversee the lifecycle of backend IT systems, from initial architectural design to ongoing maintenance and eventual decommissioning.

  • Drive the technical evaluation and implementation of new infrastructure tools and services to support company growth.

  • Document infrastructure designs, system configurations, and operational procedures to ensure knowledge sharing and business continuity.

Qualifications

  • 6-8 years of experience in IT, with a strong focus on infrastructure or systems engineering in a cloud-first environment.

  • Deep expertise in managing and securing Cloud-based services (SaaS/IaaS) and Identity Providers (e.g., Okta, Azure AD).

  • Proven experience with Zero Trust frameworks, SAML, SSO, and advanced authentication technologies.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Network Security (VPN, Firewalls, DNS, DHCP) and connectivity in a distributed global environment.

  • Proficiency in scripting (e.g., Python, Bash, or PowerShell) to automate system administration and integrations.

  • Advanced knowledge of MDM systems (Mac and Windows) from an infrastructure and policy-level perspective.

  • Experience in managing global system integrations and API-based workflows between IT platforms.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to lead technical projects and collaborate across Engineering and Security teams.

  • Ability to work independently and manage complex infrastructure migrations with minimal supervision.

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all. 

Some things you’ll enjoy

  • Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location

  • Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country

  • The flexibility of remote work, including optional WeWork access

At Deel, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of  race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @deel.com and other acquired company emails like @payspace.com and @paygroup.com. You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page.

Deel is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects different abilities, backgrounds, beliefs, experiences, identities and perspectives.

Deel will provide accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via this link and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation. If you have difficulty accessing the form, please email at recruiting@deel.com.

As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations.

This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. As a fully remote company, we also utilise AI-powered deepfake and fraud detection technologies to verify the authenticity of candidate identities and interactions during assessments and interviews. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. Your personal data is not used to train AI models. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Policy.

  • For NYC Residents: In accordance with NYC Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on AEDT; results are available at Ashby, Covey.

Collaborating closely with support, sales, and success teams, you will ensure a seamless feedback loop, enabling continuous product improvements. You will have the opportunity to directly engage with our users, gaining invaluable insights into their specific use cases and challenges and integrating those in our product. This is an instrumental, cross-functional role that will be pivotal in our scaling efforts.

What you will enjoy working on:

  • Lead large-scale cross-functional projects focused on product improvement, innovation, and enhancing user experience.

  • Collect, quantify, and prioritize product-related challenges for consideration by our product and engineering teams in future development.

  • Seek information and contribute to the building and shaping of our product, solving conceptual problems along the way.

  • Drive major company launches and global rollouts, ensuring successful product deployments.

  • Dive deep into data and analyze user feedback to derive insights that drive continuous product improvements.

  • Identify root causes of issues and develop effective solutions to address them.

  • Design and implement complex operational systems and processes to optimize product operations.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in product operations, product management, or a closely related operational role working closely with product and engineering teams.

  • Passion for delivering exceptional user experiences and a proven ability to develop a deep understanding of complex products and their various use cases.

  • Proficiency in data analysis, extracting meaningful insights, and utilizing them to drive product enhancements.

  • Ability to empathize with user problems, understanding pain points and needs to effectively shape product decisions.

  • Strong multitasking skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Problem-focused and solutions-oriented mindset with exceptional attention to detail and a hands-on approach to getting things done.

  • General technical knowledge of software development processes and systems (experience in designing and building payment systems is a significant advantage).

  • Strong Program Management skills

Summary

We are seeking a dedicated Compliance Officer to lead our regulatory efforts in the UAE. You will serve as the primary liaison with local regulators, ensuring that our operations adhere to the highest standards of financial integrity. This role requires a blend of technical expertise in AML/CTF, hands-on operational management, and a deep understanding of the unique UAE regulatory landscape.

Responsibilities

  • Regulatory Management: Act as the key point of contact with local regulators and be the point of contact to address first-level regulator, client, and management queries in respect to AML and Payment Services Licenses.

  • Program Development: Develop, implement, and monitor AML, KYC, and Sanctions programs specifically tailored to UAE federal laws and DIFC-specific regulations.

  • Operational Compliance: Execute day-to-day screening, risk rating, and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) for clients, ensuring compliance with non-cash payment services and client money regulations.

  • Due Diligence: Efficiently execute KYC, KYB, Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), and other payment-related compliance reviews to safeguard our customers, our partners, and our business

  • Reporting: Undertake and implement all required reporting to authorities, including Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and Annual Compliance Returns, as mandated by CBUAE and DIFC.

  • Risk Framework: Execute a robust risk assessment framework and client/individual risk rating, ongoing monitoring/screening, and further investigations.

  • Internal Advisory: Provide expert guidance and training to staff on local compliance matters, regulatory updates, and best practices within the fintech sector.

  • Policy Maintenance: Periodically review and update all Product Guides, disclosure documentation, and internal policies to ensure they meet evolving local licensing requirements.

  • Audit & Governance: Work with local corporate auditors and provide regular reports for board and compliance committee meetings and liaise with senior management on escalations, positive/false positive screening results, and performing EDD to seek appropriate mitigations and sign-off.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with global teams and local stakeholders (Sales, Finance, Operations) to enhance anti-fraud systems and maintain a robust AML framework.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Working with key stakeholders such as Implementation, Operations, Sales, Finance, Treasury/Banking teams and Group Compliance to execute, monitor, maintain and enhance a robust AML framework with continuous improvements.

  • Enterprise Risk: Working with Group Compliance and any external consultants to derive robust Enterprise Wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) reporting and maintaining regular EWRA assessment to ensure robust and adequate AML risk framework in accordance with UAE federal laws and local licensing guidelines.

  • Automation & Optimization: Manage any automation, continuous improvements and ongoing AML review, automation and improvement processes and workflows.


Qualifications & Requirements

  • Professional Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience within a Fintech or Payment Institution environment.

  • Proven experience working directly with the Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE) and the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC).

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field.

  • In-depth understanding of the UAE regulatory framework, particularly concerning payment services and financial crime prevention.

  • Experience in MLRO role, FinCrime operations, AML compliance, or related fields, preferably within the payroll industry or financial services and payments sector.

  • Highly effective communication skills, both written and verbal, high attention to detail, and strong interpersonal skills..

  • Ability to drive, build and work independently. Exceptional organizational, project management, and operational skills, with a knack for creating and implementing efficient processes, ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously across multiple departments and geographical regions.

  • Attention to detail, with the ability to work accurately in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, both independently and cross-functionally.

  • Problem-solving and decision-making abilities to address issues and make sound judgments related to licensing matters.

  • Entrepreneurial drive with a start-up mentality.

  • Professional certificates/qualifications in compliance, AML/CFT, risk management, finance, and/or fintech or relevant certification are nice to have but not required.

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all. 

Some things you’ll enjoy

  • Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location

  • Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country

  • The flexibility of remote work, including optional WeWork access

Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @deel.com and other acquired company emails like @payspace.com and @paygroup.com. You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page.

Deel will provide accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities. If you have difficulty accessing the form, please email at recruiting@deel.com.

The Team

The Data Platform team at Deel is dedicated to building a secure, high-performance infrastructure that empowers our 100+ data professionals. In 2026, our core mission has expanded: we aren't just moving data; we are ensuring its integrity and security. As we scale, your primary focus will be architecting and implementing a robust, unified permission system across our modern data stack—ensuring the right people have the right access at the right time, while keeping Deel compliant with global standards.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain efficient data pipelines (ETL processes) to integrate data from various source systems into the data warehouse.

  • Architect Permissions-as-Code: Design and implement scalable Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) models within Snowflake and Looker.

  • Unify the Stack: Create a seamless bridge between data warehouse roles and BI tool permissions, ensuring that security policies in Snowflake (like Row-Level Security) are accurately reflected in Looker.

  • Audit & Comply: Support internal and external audits by building automated reporting on data access, usage, and compliance status (GDPR, SOC2, etc.).

  • Develop and optimize data warehouse schemas and tables to support analytics and reporting needs.

  • Write and refine complex SQL queries and use scripting (e.g., Python) to transform and aggregate large datasets.

  • Implement data quality measures (such as validation checks and cleansing routines) to ensure data integrity and reliability.

  • Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and other engineers to understand data requirements and deliver appropriate solutions.

  • Document pipeline designs, data flows, and data definitions for transparency and future reference, adhering to team standards.

  • Handle multiple tasks or projects simultaneously, prioritizing work and communicating progress to stakeholders to meet deadlines.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics).

Summary

The Health & Safety Associate will play a key role in supporting the health, safety, and well-being of Deel employees as we continue to grow globally. This position contributes to the development and implementation of health and safety programs, helps ensure compliance with regulations, and supports the promotion of a safe and healthy work environment across all regions.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in monitoring compliance with ISO 45001 and ISO 45003 standards across the organization.

  • Support safety inspections and track follow-up actions to address potential hazards.

  • Contribute to the development and implementation of safety and prevention initiatives.

  • Help coordinate risk assessments and support the creation of preventive plans.

  • Provide support in designing safe workplaces and contribute to training material preparation.

  • Assist in maintaining up-to-date knowledge of applicable international health and safety regulations.

  • Help facilitate health and safety trainings and awareness initiatives.

  • Support emergency preparedness efforts and first aid protocols.

  • Assist in incident reporting, tracking, and analysis to identify trends and recommend improvements.

  • Support ergonomic reviews and job safety assessments in collaboration with relevant teams.

  • Collect and analyze data related to health and safety performance and help compile regular reports.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Industrial Hygiene, or a related field.

  • General understanding of international health and safety standards.

  • Strong organizational and communication skills.

  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a global, remote-first environment.

  • Experience with data tracking, reporting, and document management.

  • Familiarity with ISO 45001 and ISO 45003 is a plus.

  • Experience or interest in health and safety in remote or distributed work environments is a plus.

About the Role

We are hiring a B2B Marketplace Operations Manager to serve as the operational architect for Deel’s transition to a curated B2B ecosystem. This role is at the center of our "one-marketplace" experience, ensuring app discovery, license management, service referral and software resale motions operate in one connected flow. You will lead the effort to turn marketplace activity into a high-impact revenue stream while ensuring a frictionless experience for Deel’s customers.

Key Responsibilities

Marketplace Operations

  • Own day-to-day operations of Deel’s app resale and marketplace infrastructure (web + in-platform).

  • Maintain accurate partner and app listings including positioning, pricing context, service model (managed vs. self-managed), and geographic coverage.

  • Ensure the marketplace operates as a trusted single source of truth for internal GTM teams and customers.

App Resale Motion Enablement

  • Support execution of app resale motions across priority partners/vendors and categories.

  • Operationalize workflows for license provisioning, transfers, and renewal routing.

  • Help distinguish and operationalize managed vs. self-managed resale offerings in collaboration with Ops/GTM stakeholders.

  • Coordinate with Procurement and partner/vendor stakeholders as resale workflows evolve from manual to API-assisted operations.

Quality, Curation & Partner Tier Governance

  • Apply and maintain a high bar for client-facing marketplace quality.

  • Prioritize differentiated B2B solutions over low-signal, non-strategic offerings.

  • Implement tiering and filtering logic so high-fit partners receive high-fit lead flow.

  • Own the continuous evaluation of partner relevance by segment, use case, and market demand.

Lead Flow, Monetization, & Commercial Tracking

  • Manage lead distribution and track reciprocal value exchange from resale and marketplace partners.

  • Support governance of discounts, margin logic, and commercial terms visibility.

  • Track key monetization KPIs and partner performance with RevOps and Partnerships.

  • Own operational reporting on outbound referrals, conversion, and resale contribution.

Internal Enablement & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the go-to resource for AEs, CSMs, and OBMs for partner and app referral routing and general inquiries.

  • Create clear internal guidance on partner and app selection, alternatives, and customer-fit use cases.

  • Surface field feedback to inform roadmap, partner prioritization, and marketplace UX improvements.

  • Collaborate with Product Partnerships and Partner Marketing on campaigns and bundles to build initial and sustained long-term adoption of the web and in-platform marketplaces.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years in B2B marketplace, partner, ecosystem, GTM operations, or a related SaaS/tech role.

  • Experience supporting resale, licensing, procurement-adjacent workflows, or partner commercial programs.

  • Strong operational execution across data integrity, process design, and cross-functional coordination.

  • Solid understanding of B2B software categories (HRIS, ATS, security, finance, productivity, IT ops).

  • Ability to define and enforce quality/tiering standards in partner ecosystems.

  • Comfort with revenue-share / discount mechanics and performance tracking.

  • Strong communication and documentation skills for partner positioning and GTM enablement.

  • Bonus: experience with marketplace and app store operations.

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all. 

Some things you’ll enjoy

About the Knowledge Team

Knowledge is not just a supporting function at Deel - it’s the foundation of our product and one of the core reasons customers choose us. When a company uses Deel to hire globally, they’re not just outsourcing payroll or compliance; they’re buying instant access to deep, always-up-to-date expertise on how work gets done in 100+ countries. That knowledge powers everything from contract creation to tax calculation to leave policies - and it’s what gives our platform its competitive edge. And, it is what grounds our AI Products. In short, Knowledge is the most foundational building block at Deel.

The Sales Development Representative plays a critical role in driving top-of-funnel growth across a defined segment or product.
